title: Extend overdue loans
statementMd:
Extend the due date of every unreturned loan by 14 days (use `date(due_date, '+14 days')`), then count how many of them are still overdue as of 2024-07-01.

Expected columns: `still_overdue`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
UPDATE loans SET due_date = date(due_date, '+14 days') WHERE return_date IS NULL; SELECT COUNT(*) AS still_overdue FROM loans WHERE return_date IS NULL AND due_date < '2024-07-01';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
